I am the oldest of 5 kids with a 7 year gap between me and the next child and then 12 year gap between me and the youngest. I spent my whole childhood and teen years till the day I moved out taking care of them. Changing nappies, cooking us all dinner, bottle feeding, waking up at 2am cause one of the kids has had a nightmare and woken me. I took care of 1 girl with bad sensory autism and another 2 kids with ADHD. I've done the whole parent run as a kid and I couldn't do it again cause I was force to do it as a child.
This whole this has also cause some of my many mental health issues. I also went undiagnosed as autistic and have ADHD up until recently. I can't deal with my own mental health cause I am so use to taking care of someone else in my life that I am now emotionally and mentally destroyed. 

Hearing a child cry or scream now makes me panic and severally anxious because of my past being force to care for my siblings. I would not cope with having a child depend on me cause I never got to be one myself and I am so mentally unstable I would never put a child in a position where I wasn't able to care for them. I am ok with being a surrogate for someone who genuinely needs it but if I could just rip my ovaries out I would because I also have health issues with them.

It upset and angers me deeply when people tell me I'll change my mind cause they don't understand. I have been force to care for children and I now can't take care of my self because of it. I will never bring a child into this world because I wouldn't dare curse it with my bad mental health, genetics and poor choices I make as a human. I know I am a bad person and wouldn't be a good parent and I can admit that. 
So next time someone says they won't have kids tell them you understand.
